statement.description:
Xenia lives in a city that has $ n $ houses built along the main ringroad. The ringroad houses are numbered 1 through $ n $ in the clockwise order. The ringroad traffic is one way and also is clockwise.

Xenia has recently moved into the ringroad house number 1. As a result, she's got $ m $ things to do. In order to complete the $ i $ -th task, she needs to be in the house number $ a_{i} $ and complete all tasks with numbers less than $ i $ . Initially, Xenia is in the house number 1, find the minimum time she needs to complete all her tasks if moving from a house to a neighboring one along the ringroad takes one unit of time.
statement.formatI: The first line contains two integers $ n $ and $ m $ $ (2<=n<=10^{5},1<=m<=10^{5}) $ . The second line contains $ m $ integers $ a_{1},a_{2},...,a_{m} $ $ (1<=a_{i}<=n) $ . Note that Xenia can have multiple consecutive tasks in one house.
statement.formatO:
Print a single integer — the time Xenia needs to complete all tasks.

Please, do not use the %lld specifier to read or write 64-bit integers in С++. It is preferred to use the cin, cout streams or the %I64d specifier.
statement.hint: In the first test example the sequence of Xenia's moves along the ringroad looks as follows: $ 1→2→3→4→1→2→3 $ . This is optimal sequence. So, she needs 6 time units.

translation.description:
Xenia 住在一个有 $n$ 个房子的城市，这些房子都建在主环路上。环路上的房子按照顺时针方向从 $1$ 到 $n$ 编号。环路上的交通是单向的，也就是顺时针行驶。

Xenia 最近搬进了环路上的 $1$ 号房子。因此，她有 $m$ 件事情要做。为了完成第 $i$ 项任务，她必须到达编号为 $a_i$ 的房子，并且完成所有编号小于 $i$ 的任务。最开始，Xenia 在 $1$ 号房子。请你计算她完成所有任务所需的最少时间，如果她每走到相邻的下一个房子需要一个时间单位。
translation.formatI:
第一行包含两个整数 $n$ 和 $m$，$2 \le n \le 10^5,\,1 \le m \le 10^5$。  
第二行包含 $m$ 个整数 $a_1,a_2,\ldots,a_m$，$1 \le a_i \le n$。注意，Xenia 可能会有多个连续任务在同一个房子。
translation.formatO: 输出一个整数，表示 Xenia 完成所有任务所需的最少时间。
translation.hint:
在第一个测试样例中，Xenia 沿环路的移动顺序为：$1 \to 2 \to 3 \to 4 \to 1 \to 2 \to 3$。这是最优方案。因此，她需要 $6$ 个时间单位。
